newsitem.title: USA: Grossman's seeks stock/claims acquisition notice.
newsitem.headline: Grossman's seeks stock/claims acquisition notice.

text.p: Grossman's Inc and its two subsidiaries said Wednesday they asked a federal bankruptcy court in Delaware to establish procedures requiring prior written notice to them by any party or group proposing to acquire certain shares or pre-petition unsecured claims.

The companies said it asked that the procedures apply to those who may acquire shares of Grossman's stock resulting in a block holding of more than 1.35 million shares and to those who acquire pre-petition unsecured claims against them resulting in more than a $5 million block of those claims.
They proposed that, if they object during a 30-day period after a notice is issued, the transaction would become effective only upon court approval.

Grossman's said the relief was necessary to protect its net operating loss carry-forwards of about $300 million as of December 31. The amount is critical to their ability to reorganize, they said. They said their motion has been set for a hearing on May 14.

Grossman's operates 15 stores under the name Contractors' Warehouse in California, Indiana, Kentucky and Ohio and 28 stores under the name Mr. 2nd's Bargain Outlet in Massachusetts, New York and Rhode Island.
Grossman's and the subsidiaries, GRS Holding Co Inc and GRS Realty Co Inc, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on April 7.
